```{r}
library(arrow)
library(tidyverse)

# Setting repo path
repo_path <- "/Users/namomac/Desktop/Moneyball_FC/"

# Read the UEFA standings data
uefa_standings <- read_parquet(paste0(repo_path, "inputs/uefa_standing.parquet"))

# Inspect the structure
glimpse(uefa_standings)
```
```{r}
# CreatingUEFA data for merging
club_uefa <- uefa_standings %>%
  select(
    Club,
    Country,
    uefa_rank = Pos,           # Renaming for clarity
    uefa_coefficient = Total_Pts  # Renaming for clarity
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Centering UEFA coefficient for interpretation
    uefa_coef_cen = uefa_coefficient - mean(uefa_coefficient, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Creating categorical tiers based on ranking
    uefa_tier = case_when(
      uefa_rank <= 5 ~ "Elite (Top 5)",
      uefa_rank <= 10 ~ "Top 10",
      uefa_rank <= 15 ~ "Top 15",
      TRUE ~ "Top 21"
    ),
    uefa_tier = factor(uefa_tier, levels = c("Elite (Top 5)", "Top 10", 
                                               "Top 15", "Top 21"))
  )

# Displaying the prepared data
print(club_uefa)
```
